answer: A sybil tax charges every fake identity a sunk cost it never recovers. To join, an agent pays a 40-unit entry tax, lighting a lantern record that marks it verified; the payment is burned, not staked. A farm wanting 1,000 identities must burn 40,000 units for a 50-unit epoch reward, a loss no farm survives. Honest agents pay once, cross the ridge into the economy, and keep rewards whole, since their pearl of reputation is never diluted by copies.
